purpose: Exploratory four-arm physical matrix for immutable method storage without duplicate names or spare capacity
safety: Guarded private mount/PID/net namespace, before/after stock health and owned-directory cleanup per run
memory: End-of-window proc counts are diagnostic, not precise memory acceptance. Independently measure retained and construction-peak requested Rust heap with actual ADD_OBJECT dispatch on both versions.
failure_rule: Stop on collection, correctness, identity, health or cleanup failure; retain raw failed window
analysis: All per-block values and paired medians. New high-resolution own-process CPU fields are separate from old tick+reaped-child fields. Four blocks are exploratory, no formal superiority/equivalence verdict. Do not pool pre-power-loss samples.
hypothesis: One canonical method blob supplies the ACL name. Boxed immutable blobs and method lists remove duplicate names and unused capacity. Check all latency, own-process CPU and full-daemon memory diagnostics; do not infer speed from allocations.
retention_rule: Reject correctness failures. Do not claim full superiority or promote this runtime change on pilot point estimates alone. Report all latency/CPU signs, memory diagnostics, and allocation-only evidence separately. Investigate apparent new regressions before retaining.
build_control: Same actual /tmp/owrt-core-release/ubusd source root, SDK, toolchain, cwd and release flags as before; previous exact-root reconstruction reproduced before bytes.
client_control: Frozen ca1a912 client and dependencies plus only process CPU clocks; same binary on all four arms. Do not pool R95/R96 measurements.
